text.p: Lindeteves-Jacoberg Ltd said on Friday it was proposing a renounceable rights issue of Singapore $29.6 million in loan stock.

It said in a statement the 1.5 percent unsecured loan stock due 2002 would be offered to shareholders on the basis of $1 principal amount of loan stock, with one warrant for every five shares held at the books closure date.
Each warrant would carry the right to subscribe for one new ordinary share of S$0.20 each in the capital of the company.
The company said it hoped to raise about S$10 million for a sewage treatment project and S$19.1 million to refinance bank borrowings.
It said the rights issue was subject to the approval of shareholders and the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
